title: Claude Code command frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of .claude/commands/<name>.md (the legacy slash-command format: the skill fields minus name and paths; the command name is the file name). Human-authored: no schemaVersion, kind or provenance. x-maxwell records what the command touches so the write guard and KPI attribution can reason about it. Claude Code also accepts hooks, shell, metadata, license and compatibility in command files; Maxwell refuses them deliberately: commands are thin entry points over workflows (hooks stay in .claude/settings.json, the shell is always bash, and agentskills.io metadata belongs on skills)

examples.description: Run every Maxwell validator (layout, schemas, data, frontmatter, workflows, mirror) and report problems by path

description.description: One-line purpose shown in /help and used by the model to decide whether to invoke the command

argument-hint.description: Argument placeholder shown during autocomplete, e.g. '<company_id> [--dry-run]'

arguments.description: Named positional arguments substituted as $<name> in the body; a space-separated string or a YAML list

allowed-tools.description: Tools the command may use without prompting, as a comma or space separated string or an array of 'Tool' / 'Tool(specifier)' entries

disallowed-tools.description: Tools removed from the inherited set while the command runs; same shape as allowed-tools

model.description: Model the command runs with: an alias (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, inherit) or a full claude-* model id

disable-model-invocation.description: When true only a human can invoke the command; the model will not call it on its own

user-invocable.description: When false the command is hidden from the / menu and only the model can invoke it

context.description: fork runs the command in a forked subagent context instead of the main conversation; required whenever agent or background is set

agent.description: Subagent (from .claude/agents) that executes the command when context is fork

background.description: When true the forked command runs in the background; only meaningful with context fork

x-maxwell.description: Maxwell metadata not interpreted by Claude Code

xMaxwell.description: Declares the workflow a command fronts, the workspace paths it may write and whether it needs decrypted credentials. touches is enforced by the write guard; readsCredentials true means SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE must be present

workflow.description: Workflow this command invokes or is the entry point for

touches.description: Workspace paths or globs the command may create or modify; empty means read-only
